description: This file defines functions related to the setup, teardown, and initialization of an IPsec XFRM protocol configuration in a networking context. It includes functions to configure tunnels, handle JSON data, and register protocol components.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_setup
methods.description: Configures an IPsec XFRM tunnel with parameters from the JSON data.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down the XFRM configuration; currently does nothing.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration parameters for XFRM protocol.
